banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the table - the Table 61 grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes (the grid opening on capture p. 108 of the print pass with the religion and tea ceremony rows printing at the top of p. 109; compressed p. 56 carrying the full grid); every printed cell agrees, marker for marker - zero contested cells. The grid pins as a table: the court rows 0 calligraphy, 1 etiquette, 2 falconry, 3 flower arranging, 4 heraldry, 5 landscape gardening, 6 noh, 7 origami, 8 painting, 9 poetry, 10 religion and 11 tea ceremony riding the first column comment, three data columns - the proficiency slots required (calligraphy, falconry and tea ceremony 2, the rest 1), the base chance of success (18, 16, 17, 15, 12, 16, 17, 14, 19, 19, 12, 15) and the always-roll marker (1 for etiquette, falconry and heraldry, 0 for the other nine). The asterisk (further-explanation) markers ride the row comments - calligraphy, etiquette, falconry, heraldry, noh, religion and tea ceremony carry it; the court prose explanations stay with their own rounds. The table tag T61Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson. This round closes the Chapter 6 proficiencies arc - the Table 56 and Tables 58-61 grids plus the weapon, missile, non-weapon and character prose all landed
